methodology.clean_specification_stage: Agent B rewrites sanitized observations into source-independent user needs, states, safeguards, and acceptance criteria.
methodology.deferred_reason: Independent current-source red team found unresolved target-facet or canonical-anchor collisions before neutral comparison.

results.neutral_actor_user_need: An authenticated, authorized care-record user needs to create or amend an observation and retrieve it within the relevant person and care-context register.
preconditions: The person and care context are active.
Any amended record belongs to the active person.
results.trigger_input: The actor submits a preliminary record containing validated top-level fields and optional subordinate measurements.
states_transitions: Preliminary to validation attempted to persisted.
An existing persisted record may become an updated persisted version after ownership and validation checks.
success_evidence: The top-level record and subordinate measurements persist together.
Register and review results can be restricted by person, care context, record template, and top-level record.
failure_recovery: Authorization denial, request-integrity failure, invalid input, cross-person amendment, and persistence failure produce explicit failure outcomes.
A persistence failure rolls back the parent and subordinate writes.
authorization_privacy_direct_object: Creation and amendment require record authority.
An amendment is rejected when the referenced record does not belong to the active person.
results.audit_provenance: No durable success audit or additional provenance requirement is directly supported.
results.concurrency_idempotency: No locking, duplicate-request protection, or automated retry behavior is directly supported.
negative_edge_acceptance: Unauthorized submission persists nothing.
Failed request integrity persists nothing.
Invalid top-level or subordinate data cannot partially persist.
Cross-person amendment is rejected.
A subordinate-write failure rolls back the top-level and all subordinate writes.
Register filters limit results to the requested person, care context, template, and top-level record.
A preliminary record is not represented as completed before validation and persistence.
agent_c_evaluation_questions_not_upstrea: Concealment or explicit denial for inaccessible direct identifiers.
Stronger provenance, retention, and audit obligations.
collision_exclusions: Questionnaire completion is not separate workflow ownership merely because it may be nested content.
Approval, sign-off, and escalation are excluded.
results.no_copy_attestation: Derived only from the sanitized behavior packet; no repository identity, source path, source artifact, or distinctive design was received.

results.neutral_actor_user_need: An authenticated, authorized care-record user needs to create or amend a clinical event associated with a person and optionally a related care visit.
preconditions: The actor has general create or update authority.
The actor has any additional authority required by the selected event category.
results.trigger_input: The actor submits a new or existing event container with person context, optional visit association, and zero or more related clinical items.
states_transitions: Related clinical items may be created, updated, or revalidated.
Invalidation and restoration are distinct actions, not ordinary editing.
success_evidence: The event container is persisted or updated with permitted associations.
Related items are processed according to their validation rules.
Read results exclude information the viewer is not permitted to see.
failure_recovery: Missing general authority or category-specific authority causes failure.
A transaction boundary exists, but rollback behavior for every checked failure path is not established.
authorization_privacy_direct_object: Create/update authority is checked separately from category-specific authority.
results.audit_provenance: No durable audit requirement is directly supported.
results.concurrency_idempotency: No locking, conflict handling, duplicate-request protection, or user-facing retry is directly supported.
negative_edge_acceptance: Unauthenticated creation or amendment is denied.
General create authority without category-specific authority is insufficient.
Update authority without authority for the existing event category is insufficient.
Related clinical items are processed or revalidated rather than silently assumed valid.
Unauthorized associated information is excluded on read.
Invalidation or restoration is not inferred from ordinary editing.
Rollback after a checked partial-processing failure remains unspecified.
agent_c_evaluation_questions_not_upstrea: Authority over the visit and every associated clinical item.
Minimum-necessary disclosure and NZ health-information safeguards.
not_established: Atomic success across every related item
Review, follow-up, escalation, or incident resolution
collision_exclusions: A compound clinical record container is not proof of one indivisible clinical occurrence.
Review, follow-up, escalation, incident management, and closure are excluded.
results.no_copy_attestation: Derived only from the sanitized behavior packet; no repository identity, source path, source artifact, or distinctive design was received.

results.neutral_actor_user_need: An authenticated, authorized reviewer needs to progress an accessible incident record through review and close it only after required investigation outputs and improvement actions exist.
preconditions: The record exists and is accessible to the actor.
The actor has edit authority within the applicable scope.
results.trigger_input: The actor submits a lifecycle action against the existing record with evidence required for that transition.
states_transitions: Recorded to under investigation to cause documented to improvement actions established to closed.
Each transition follows the stated order.
success_evidence: Closure succeeds only after investigation, cause documentation, and required improvement actions exist.
Closure records the responsible actor and time.
Updates and lifecycle transitions produce audit actions.
failure_recovery: Invalid transitions, missing records, inaccessible records, and processing failures produce explicit failures.
An inaccessible direct reference does not disclose object existence.
authorization_privacy_direct_object: The actor is authenticated, has edit authority, and has access to the referenced scope.
Direct reference to an inaccessible object is concealed.
results.audit_provenance: Updates and lifecycle steps create audit evidence; closure records actor and time.
results.concurrency_idempotency: No locking, concurrent-transition resolution, duplicate-request protection, or replay behavior is directly supported.
negative_edge_acceptance: Unauthenticated or unauthorized lifecycle action is denied.
An inaccessible direct reference does not reveal existence.
Missing records fail explicitly.
Skipping a required lifecycle phase is rejected.
Missing investigation evidence, cause, or required improvement actions prevents closure.
Valid closure records state, actor, time, and audit action.
Processing failure is explicit while rollback and partial-write behavior remain unspecified.
Concurrent closure outcome remains unspecified and must not be assumed.
agent_c_evaluation_questions_not_upstrea: Visibility of sensitive incident details and witness/subject boundaries.
Control Room coordination and atomic improvement-action linkage.
not_established: Atomicity between improvement action and closure
collision_exclusions: Equivalence from a quality-remediation lifecycle to an incident workflow is not established.
Initial submission, reopening, H&S governance, regulatory reporting, and Control Room transitions are excluded.
results.no_copy_attestation: Derived only from the sanitized behavior packet; no repository identity, source path, source artifact, or distinctive design was received.

overall_credit_statement: Zero benchmark credit; these neutral specifications provide no benchmark selection, current-product comparison, native-design mapping, or capability credit.
